title: Product noise kernel
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $x\in\Omega^n$. The product noise kernel at $x$ is the probability distribution on $\Omega^n$ obtained by independently applying to each coordinate the noise rule that retains its value with probability $\rho$ and otherwise draws from $\pi$.
